name: jinleili/simuverse
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: WGSL distance kernel updates both endpoints in-place, uses uniform compliance and epsilon length denominator, skips inverse-mass sum below .01. No accumulated lambda in this kernel; correctness requires non-overlapping constraint groups and verified host dt scaling.

name: alexrodag/spg
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Substep orchestration predicts positions then projects per-energy stencil groups in OpenMP parallel Gauss-Seidel, serial fallback, reconstructs velocities. Group conflict freedom and actual energy projection still require inspection; this is solver scheduling reading.

name: openxrlab/xrtailor
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: CUDA particle collision reads shared input positions and writes per-particle delta/count; mass-weighted distance projection plus friction helper. Neighbor termination uses j>num_particles, so validity of equality/sentinel must be checked before indexing. Pair particles are not a triangle CCD guarantee.

name: ximiwu/Potentia
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Serialized Taichi constraint loop computes alpha=1/(stiffness*dt²), includes alpha*current_lambda and accumulates lambda. Zero stiffness guard and lambda lifecycle are not established here; iteration callbacks catch and print exceptions.

name: ChengzhuUwU/libAtsSim
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Executable triangle StVK energy uses Green strain, .5*lambda*trace(E)^2+mu*||E||²; Piola stress lambda*trace(E)*F+2*mu*F*E. Nearby comment simplifies formula incorrectly; use executable expression. Isotropic triangle law has no calibrated tissue fibers in this block.

name: bailus/Cloth
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Distance projection scales full relative vector by .8 and moves both particles oppositely; no inv-mass/compliance/dt in satisfy itself, zero current length is unguarded. Effective correction also depends on Particle::move not read here.

name: srl-ethz/sors
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Sparse LDLT Newton direction, Armijo energy backtracking halves alpha with unbounded while(true); convergence tests accepted displacement norm, not force residual. Failed convergence throws, but linear-solve status, descent guarantee and backtracking floor not checked in viewed method.

name: mattoverby/mpm-optimization
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: Implicit grid-velocity objective combines elastic energy at F_new=(I+dt*grad(v))*F with mass-weighted velocity change. L-BFGS minimizes objective then copies velocities and explicitly adds gravity. Viewed caller does not inspect optimizer convergence before committing.

name: Wumpf/blub
reading_scope: Bounded code reading; no full audit/build/benchmark
finding: WebGPU pressure PCG host stages apply A, reduce alpha, update pressure/residual, periodically reduce max error, two-pass preconditioner then beta. Indirect dispatch supports GPU-side no-ops after convergence; host comments are not proof of residual kernel correctness.
